## Intent — what this is for

Follow-on to EIAT-1/EIAT-2, core only — the missing half of the source→inbox seam: IncomingMessage.kind plus its validated resolution into InboxItem.item_kind. The app-side writers (mail-inbox → email, a channel source → mention) are apps-repo work and out of scope.

## Done when

A source declaring kind="email" (or "mention") produces a row whose PERSISTED item_kind is that kind, selected by GET /api/inbox?kind=email, counted in GET /api/inbox/kinds, and equal to the value the dashboard's kind filter compares — proven by a round trip driven from the filesystem source's own inbox/incoming/ directory through poll → ingest → disk → API, not by a dataclass unit test; a kind outside the channel-shaped set (including core's own non-channel attention kinds) is REFUSED with a warning naming the source and the rejected value while the row still arrives as message (never silently, never dropped); SOURCE_DECLARABLE_KINDS is asserted equal to ItemKind minus NON_CHANNEL_KINDS so a future enum member cannot skip the decision, and every declarable kind has a frontend chip (parity test against inboxMeta.ts); inert-surface-baseline.json regenerated on the shrink (enum:ItemKind.EMAIL + enum:ItemKind.MENTION cleared, 154 → 152); make lint + targeted pytest + make test green.
